Imagine using your voice to guide an AI as you code, turning ideas into working prototypes fast.

Meet Vibe Coder, our experimental, open-source take on voice-driven coding aka #vibecoding (shout out to @karpathy for coining this catchy term).

We’ve been tinkering with how voice commands + AI can transform the coding experience, and we’re excited to share our new VS Code extension that works with AI-powered IDEs like #Cursor and #Windsurf.

This isn’t a polished product (yet) - it’s our first take on what we believe could be the future of software development.

Vibe Coder is live on Product Hunt, check it out here: https://t.co/8MvWXY3h8J

Download it, take it for a spin, and tell us what you think. 👇
